query: Stepwise generation of erythroid progenitors and enucleated red blood cells from human pluripotent stem cells
title: PSC-RED, an Albumin-Free Robust Erythroid Differentiation Method to Produce Enucleated Red Blood Cells from Human Pluripotent Stem Cells
markdown:
## Protocol: Stepwise generation of erythroid progenitors and enucleated red blood cells from human pluripotent stem cells

### Overview

This protocol outlines the stepwise generation of erythroid progenitors and enucleated red blood cells from human pluripotent stem cells (hPSCs). It includes preparation of hPSCs, short and long differentiation pathways using specific cytokine supplements, and final characterization steps including cell enumeration, flow cytometry, enucleation assessment, staining, filtration, and HPLC analysis.

### Materials/Reagents

E8 medium, IMIT medium, R5 medium, R6 medium, Alsever's solution (Sigma), Vitronectin, 5mM EDTA in PBS, TrypleSelect 1x, PBS, Luna-FL dual channel Automated Cell Counter reagents (acridine orange, propidium iodide), Flow cytometry antibodies (CD34, CD36, CD43, CD45, CD71, CD235a/glycophorin A from BD Biosciences and eBioscience), DRAQ5 DNA nuclear stain (ThermoFisher), Rapid Romanovsky stain, PAL Acrodisc 25mm WBC filters, HPLC reagents (acetonitrile, TFA, Buffer A, Buffer B), BMP4, VEGF, bFGF, Wnt3A, Wnt5A, Activin A, GSK3β Inhibitor VIII, SCF, IGF2, TPO, PDGF, ANGPTL5, CCL28, IBMX, Heparin, UM171, SB431542, β-Estradiol, Erythropoietin (EPO), Dexamethasone, RU486, G-CSF, G-MCSF.

### Equipment

Tissue culture treated six-well plates (Falcon), 5 mL serological pipet, Nikon TE-2000S microscope, Luna-FL dual channel Automated Cell Counter (Logos), BD FACS Calibur flow cytometer (BD Biosciences) or DPX10 flow cytometer (Cytek), Flowjo software, Centrifuge, Dry ice, 37°C water bath, VYDAC C4 column, HPLC system.

### Safety & Sterility

Maintain sterile conditions throughout all cell culture steps. Use appropriate personal protective equipment when handling chemical reagents and biological samples. Dispose of biohazardous waste according to institutional guidelines.

## Analysis and Characterization

### End of experiments

1. Count cells using a Luna-FL dual channel Automated Cell Counter (Logos), utilizing acridine orange to visualize live cells and propidium iodide to exclude dead cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S01 -->
2. Evaluate iPSCs undergoing differentiation by FACS using antibodies against CD34, CD36, CD43, CD45, CD71, and CD235a (also known as glycophorin A) sourced from BD Biosciences and eBioscience. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S02 -->
3. Measure the enucleation rate using DRAQ5 DNA nuclear stain (ThermoFisher) after excluding dead cells with Propidium Iodide. Analyze cells using a BD FACS Calibur flow cytometer (BD Biosciences) or a DPX10 (Cytek) flow cytometer, and process data with Flowjo software. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S03 -->
4. Assess erythroid differentiation and enucleation microscopically by performing Rapid Romanovsky staining on cytospin preparations. Estimate cell sizes using a Nikon TE-2000S microscope and manufacturer-provided software. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S04 -->
5. Eliminate nuclei at the end of experiments by filtering RBCs using PAL Acrodisc 25mm WBC filters as recommended by the manufacturer. Store filtered cRBCs for up to one month in Alsever's solution (Sigma), noting little signs of hemolysis. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S05 -->
6. Wash cells twice with PBS and lyse them in water via three rapid freeze-thaw cycles using dry ice and a 37°C water bath. Eliminate debris by centrifugation at 16,000g and store lysates at -80°C. Perform HPLC as described (Fabry et al., 2003): filter a few µL of lysate containing about 50µg of protein in about 100 µL of 40% acetonitrile and 0.18% TFA, load onto a VYDAC C4 column, and elute globins with increasing acetonitrile concentration over approximately 80 minutes. Program the starting elution buffer to be 80% buffer A and 20% buffer B, rising to 50% buffer B in 50 minutes. Buffer A consists of 36% acetonitrile and 0.18% TFA; Buffer B consists of 56% acetonitrile and 0.18% TFA. Monitor globin chain elution by measuring O.D. at 220 nm. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S06 -->

## Differentiation Induction

### day 0

1. On day 0, induce differentiation by replacing E8 medium with IMIT medium containing supplement 1: Bone Morphogenic Protein 4 (BMP4) (10ng/mL), Vascular Endothelium Growth Factor 165 (VEGF) (10ng/mL), basic Fibroblast Growth Factor (bFGF) (10ng/mL), Wnt3A (5ng/mL), Wnt5A (5ng/mL), Activin A (5ng/mL), and GSK3β Inhibitor VIII (2µM) (Olivier et al., 2016). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S03 -->

## Long Differentiation Protocol

### after day 10

1. Centrifuge cells at 250g for three minutes. Replate day 10 cells in IMIT medium at 2x10^5/mL in the presence of supplement 4: bFGF (5ng/mL), SCF (15ng/mL), VEGF (5ng/mL), TPO (10ng/mL), IGF2 (10ng/mL), Platelet Derived Growth Factor (PDGF) (5ng/mL), Angiopoietin-like 5 (ANGPTL5) (5ng/mL), Chemokine Ligand 28 (CCL28) (5ng/mL), IBMX (30µM), Heparin (5µg/mL), and UM171 (30nM) for one or two weeks. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S01 -->
2. Keep cell concentration below 1.5x10^6 cells/mL at all times. Refresh cytokines every two days by adding 6x concentrated supplement. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S02 -->
3. After keeping cells for two weeks in these conditions, centrifuge them and transfer to fresh plates after 7 days to eliminate any attached cells. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S03 -->

### After this additional step

1. Resume differentiation according to the short protocol day 10 steps after this additional step. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S01 -->
2. Add Granulocyte-Macrophage Colony Stimulating Factor (G-MCSF) (20ng/mL) and Granulocyte Stimulating Factor (G-CSF) (20ng/mL) once to induce maximal proliferation of the HPCs in the SED supplements. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S02 -->

## Short PSC-RED Protocol

### day -1

1. Dissociate three-day-old hPSC colonies with 5mM EDTA in PBS for 6 minutes. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S01 -->
2. Remove EDTA, replace with 5 mL of E8 medium, and thoroughly flush the well with a 5 mL serological pipet by pipetting up and down 10 times to generate small clumps, producing small colonies of about 50 cells on day 0. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S02 -->
3. Plate cells at 1-2x10^5 cells/well in 2mL/well of E8 medium on vitronectin in tissue culture treated six-well plates (Falcon), which are used throughout the protocol. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S03 -->
4. Allow cells to attach overnight after plating. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S04 -->

### day 0

1. Inspect the culture before inducing differentiation to ascertain that most colonies contain about 50 cells or less. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S01 -->
2. Sacrifice one well of the culture for cell counting to calculate the yield of cells at the end of the experiments. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S02 -->
3. Induce differentiation by replacing E8 medium with IMIT medium containing supplement 1: Bone Morphogenic Protein 4 (BMP4) (10ng/mL), Vascular Endothelium Growth Factor 165 (VEGF) (10ng/mL), basic Fibroblast Growth Factor (bFGF) (10ng/mL), Wnt3A (5ng/mL), Wnt5A (5ng/mL), Activin A (5ng/mL), and GSK3β Inhibitor VIII (2µM) (Olivier et al., 2016). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T1-S03 -->

### day 2

1. On day 2, add 6x concentrated supplement 2 in IMIT to each well to achieve final concentrations of: 20ng/mL BMP-4, 30ng/mL VEGF, 5ng/mL Wnt3A, 5ng/mL Wnt5A, 5ng/mL Activin A, 2µM GSK3β Inhibitor VIII, 10ng/mL bFGF, 20ng/mL SCF, and 0.4ng/mL β-Estradiol. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T2-S01 -->

### day 3

1. On day 3, dissociate cells with TrypleSelect 1x for 5-10 minutes at 37°C. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T3-S01 -->
2. After the addition of 10 mL of PBS, cells were centrifuged for 3 minutes at 250g, the supernatant was discarded and the cells re-suspended in fresh IMIT medium containing supplement 3 (BMP4 (20ng/mL), VEGF (30ng/mL), bFGF (20ng/mL), SCF (30ng/mL), Insulin-like Growth Factor 2 (IGF2) (10ng/mL), Thrombopoietin (TPO) (10ng/mL), SB431542 (3M), Heparin (5µg/mL), IBMX (50M) and -Estradiol (0.4ng/mL) and plated at 1.105 cells/mL of a tissue culture treated six wells plate (3 mL per well). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T3-S02 -->

### day 6

1. On day 6, centrifuge cells for 3 minutes at 350g and resuspend at 5x10^5/mL in fresh IMIT medium containing supplement 3 without SB431542 but with 30nM UM171. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T4-S01 -->

### Between day 6 and day 10

1. Between day 6 and day 10, dilute cells to 0.5x10^6/mL whenever they reach more than 1.5x10^6 cells/mL by adding the same medium and supplement. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T5-S01 -->

### day 8

1. Add an additional dose of S3 supplement (from a 6x concentrated stock) at day 8 to fully renew cytokines and small molecules. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T6-S01 -->

### day 10

1. On day 10, centrifuge cells for 3 minutes at 250g and plate at 0.66x10^5 cells/mL in IMIT containing SED supplement: SCF (100ng/mL), Erythropoietin (4U/mL), IBMX (50µM), and Dexamethasone (1µM). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T7-S01 -->

### From day 10 to day 17

1. From day 10 to day 17, dilute cells to 0.5x10^6/mL whenever they reach more than 1.5x10^6 cells/mL by adding the same medium and supplement. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T8-S01 -->
2. Add 6x concentrated SED supplement in IMIT every 2 days to fully renew cytokines and small molecules. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T8-S02 -->

### day 17

1. On day 17, centrifuge cells for 3 minutes at 250g and plate at a density of about 2x10^5/mL in IMIT containing SER supplement: SCF (50ng/mL), EPO (4U/mL), and RU486 (1µM). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T9-S01 -->

### From day 17 to 24

1. From day 17 to 24, dilute cells to 0.5x10^6/mL whenever they reach more than 1.5x10^6 cells/mL by adding the same medium and supplement. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T10-S01 -->
2. Add 6x concentrated SER supplement in IMIT every 2 days to fully renew cytokines and small molecules. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T10-S02 -->

### day 24

1. On day 24, centrifuge cells for 3 minutes at 250g and plate at 2x10^5/mL in R5 medium with SER2 supplement: SCF (10ng/mL), EPO (4U/mL), and RU486 (1µM). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T11-S01 -->

### From day 24 to 31

1. From day 24 to 31, dilute cells to 0.5x10^6/mL whenever they reach more than 1.5x10^6 cells/mL by adding the same medium and supplement. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T12-S01 -->
2. Add 6x concentrated SER2 supplement in R6 every 2 days to fully renew cytokines and small molecules. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T12-S02 -->

### day 31

1. On day 31, centrifuge cells for 3 minutes at 250g and maintain in R5 or R6 medium alone for up to 8 days. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T13-S01 -->
